onboarding.title:
EXPLORE EVERY ROAD.
SHARE EVERY ROUTE.
onboarding.body: Record your rides, discover new routes and share your journey with the community.

existing.title: Welcome back!
existing.subtitle: Enter the password for your {{email}} account.

new.title: Create your account
new.subtitle: Create a password to join ROLT and have it ride along on your motorcycle trips.
new.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address linked to your account. We’ll send you a link to reset your password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.subtitle: If an account exists for this email, we’ve sent a reset link to {{email}}.
checkEmail.tip: If the email doesn’t arrive within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must be at least 8 characters.

passwordUpdated.title: Password updated
passwordUpdated.subtitle: You can keep using ROLT with your new password.

linkedAccount.title: This account uses {{provider}}
linkedAccount.subtitle: {{email}} is linked to your {{provider}} account. Sign in with {{provider}} instead of a password to continue.

accountLocked.title: Too many attempts
accountLocked.subtitle: To keep your account safe, we’ve paused password sign-in for a short while. Reset your password to continue right away.
accountLocked.countdownA11y_one: You can try again in about {{count}} minute.
accountLocked.countdownA11y_other: You can try again in about {{count}} minutes.
accountLocked.differentAccount: Sign in with a different account

resetLinkExpired.title: This link has expired
resetLinkExpired.subtitle: For your security, password reset links are valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can only be used once. Request a new link to continue.
resetLinkExpired.sentAt: The link was sent on {{date}} at {{time}}.

saveRoute.title: Sign in to save this route
saveRoute.description: With a free account you can save routes, record your rides and match with riders nearby.

generic.title: Sign in to continue
generic.description: This feature needs an account. With a free account you can save routes and rides and match with riders nearby.

errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address. Example: name@domain.com
errors.invalidCredentials: Incorrect password. Try again or reset your password.
errors.passwordTooShort: Your password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists. Go back and sign in.
errors.provider: Couldn’t sign in with {{provider}}. Try again or continue with email.
errors.network: Couldn’t connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
